name: Recycled / out-of-context media
cq: Which posts present a camera-authentic photograph as showing an event although the same photograph was public before the event began?

name: Earliest known appearance
cq: For a given image, which post is its earliest known public appearance, and on which platform and account?

name: Patient zero of a manipulation
cq: For each distinct AI-generated insertion in a near-duplicate cluster, which post and account first carried it?

name: Lineage / derivation reconstruction
cq: For every instance of an image, what is its most likely immediate parent, and which steps introduced synthetic content?

name: Source laundering
cq: Which posts credit a reputable outlet while carrying an AI insertion that the outlet never published?

name: Hidden platform hop
cq: For a file uploaded to a pass-through platform, which platform did it most recently pass through?

name: Materiality-aware fact-check triage
cq: Which undisclosed AI-altered posts alter the very entity their claim is about, ranked by reach?

name: Content-credential contradiction
cq: Which validly signed content credentials assert a capture (or a capture device) that the forensic evidence contradicts?

name: Presentation intent and disclosure
cq: Into which presentation category (disclosed synthetic, satire/art, undisclosed material, undisclosed peripheral, unaltered) does each post fall, with provenance for the inference?

name: Temporal anachronism
cq: Which AI attributions name a generator that was not yet released when the post was published?

name: Retraction / recall impact
cq: Given a known issue in one detector version, which published fact-checks rest on records from that version that contain the affected property?

name: Coordinated campaign detection
cq: Which accounts share forensic TTPs (generator, post-processing recipe) and push the same narrative within a short window?

name: Toolkit fingerprinting
cq: Which accounts apply the same generator and ordered post-processing recipe (operation classes and parameter values) to AI regions across different images?

name: Shared-device (sock puppet) linking
cq: Which account pairs post first-generation originals from the same rare camera model?

name: Detector-error triage by cross-instance consistency
cq: Which reliable AI attributions on the earliest known instance of an image are reproduced by none of its later copies, flagging a likely detector false positive?

name: Explainable audit trail
cq: For a fact-check, what is the chain from claim and post to forensic record, detector version, regions, sources, confidences and depicted entities?

name: Generator exposure by entity
cq: For each public entity, how many reliably AI-altered posts depict it, by generator and month, and with what reach?

name: Reported-versus-inferred evidence audit
cq: Which images rest only on a source-reported assertion (a content credential) with no independent forensic corroboration?
